basic_info.description: Stunning Bay Bridge & water view one bedroom home from the 33rd floor at One Rincon Hill. The coveted home features hardwood flooring throughout, the developer upgrade finish package, stainless steel appliances, custom lighting, custom window treatments, and more. In-unit washer/dryer, storage cage and one valet parking space complete the home.        One Rincon Hill building amenities include outdoor BBQ area, pool, & whirlpool, Business Center, Meeting Room, Club Room, Sky Lounge, Fitness Center, and 24 hour lobby attendant. Concierge service with mail/package holding. One Car valet Parking and storage cage included. One Rincon Hill has a dominating position at the top of Rincon Hill, which provides easy access to 101, 280, 80 and Bay Bridge. Walk to the Embarcadero, Financial District and Union Square.        **Some photos are virtually staged.**
